items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: I went on to him and taken a couple of lessons with him.

ctx.x: Had you played anything before that at all, like drums or guitar or anything?

No, never worried about music. I had the opportunity to learn to play piano, but I was a fast man at the time. Didn't have time to worry about music. So after that, I went and bought the method and started going up there twice a week. So finally, I got the first, second and third position. Learned how to make those notes in the end.
